about: Error copy round 3g, GM item 1 (option c): the Delete key asks only when a doomed node has pins or open proposals, the ones the backend's delete detaches or closes (canvas_pins.detach_node, canvas_proposals.invalidate_referencing, and an open project's cover proposal whose image only the doomed nodes show). backend/tests/test_error_copy_round3g.py runs each case through the real DELETE /api/graph/node and the asset-proposal sweep and checks `asks` is whether anything was detached or closed; frontend/tests/errorCopy.round3g.test.ts reads the same cases through lib/deleteConfirm.ts deleteLosesAttachments. Nodes are created in order, so their ids are n1, n2, n3. A node is a text input, or an image node whose one output is `image`.
